sources.kind: deposited search result (HTTP-range SQLite read, table FileInfos)

sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2017/07/PXD003969/apoe_phospho_glyco_A.msf, apoe_unmodified_A.msf, ApoE_unmodified_pH_A.msf (set B .msf files not parameter-read)
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ (BTO:0000601, EFO:0001272, NCBITaxon:10090, PRIDE:0000554, PRIDE:0000564); remaining accessions from PRIDE record and parse_sdrf validation

claims.location: comment[label] and factor value[treatment], all rows
claims.evidence: Methods: 'TMT-126/-127N/127C sham-irradiated, TMT-128N/-128C/-129N 0.3 Gy, TMT-129C/-130N/-130C 6 Gy; six biological replicates per condition'. Dose-rate mapping 1 mGy/day=0.3 Gy, 20 mGy/day=6.0 Gy from Results.

claims.value: 1-3 for set A, 4-6 for set B
claims.evidence: Six replicates per condition and 3 channels per condition per 9-plex => two sets (A,B, matching msf names). Numbering of which animal is which number is INFERRED labelling; the paper gives no per-animal table.

claims.location: comment[data file], comment[fraction identifier], all rows
claims.evidence: FileInfos of each .msf lists the raw files searched together; the 6 msf cover all 70 RAW exactly once. Fraction identifier = order in FileInfos (acquisition order); exact HILIC/mono/multi/deglyco sub-pool of each file in the phospho_glyco msf is not recorded.

claims.value: Q Exactive HF (QHF* files), Orbitrap Fusion (FUS* files)
claims.evidence: Raw headers confirm; paper: Fusion only for high-pH fractionated unmodified peptides (= ApoE_unmodified_pH msf files, FUS*).

claims.value: CAM C fixed; TMT6plex K and any N-term fixed; Phospho STY, Deamidated N variable (phospho_glyco pool only)
claims.evidence: Mascot/Sequest nodes of the msf files: StaticMod Carbamidomethyl(C), TMT6plex K and Any N-terminus; DynMod Phospho STY and Deamidated N only in apoe_phospho_glyco_A; unmodified/pH searches have no dynamic mods (written not applicable). Set B msf not read; assumed same as A.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance], comment[cleavage agent details]
claims.evidence: Mascot and Sequest HT nodes; paper Data analysis.

claims.value: HILIC (phospho_glyco pool), hpHRP (pH pool), not available (unmodified QHF pool)
claims.evidence: Methods: HILIC fractionation of modified peptides; high-pH fractionation of unmodified peptides (7 ACN steps). Unmodified QHF msf pool: fractionation not stated.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], [sex], [strain or breed], [developmental stage], [organism part], [material type]
claims.value: Mus musculus; female; B6.129P2-Apoe tm1Unc/J; adult; hippocampus; tissue
claims.evidence: Methods: female C57Bl/6 ApoE-/- mice (B6.129P2-ApoE tm1Unc/J), 8 weeks at start, sacrificed after 300 days; complete hippocampus. 'adult' follows from age ~1 year at sacrifice.
PRIDE lists Alzheimer's disease but all arms (incl. sham) are ApoE-/- model mice; disease status of individual animals not reported, so sentinel.

claims.value: sham irradiation; chronic 137Cs gamma irradiation 1 or 20 mGy/day for 300 days
claims.evidence: Methods 'Ethics statement, irradiation of animals'; free text (no ontology term fits).
Pool suffix distinguishes the three separately enriched/fractionated peptide pools of the same TMT-labelled set so row coordinates stay unique; same animals underlie PG/UN/PH sources.

limitations: Set B .msf parameters not read (assumed identical to set A).
Per-animal identity within a 3-channel triplet and replicate numbering are labelling, not stated.
Sub-pool (mono-phospho/multi-phospho/deglyco) of each file in the phospho_glyco msf not determinable.
Unmodified QHF pool (apoe_unmodified_*) sample prep not described distinctly in the paper.
Collision energy not annotated (paper states 34 V; unit ambiguity).
